content.text:
Here is the codelist for eosinophilic esophagitis. All codes come from the knowledge store.

- J1017: Eosinophilic oesophagitis
- ^ESCTEO508265: Eosinophilic esophagitis
- ^ESCT1165474: Food-induced eosinophilic oesophagitis
- ^ESCTEO508286: Eosinophilic ulcer of oesophagus

I included the eosinophilic ulcer code because it describes eosinophilic disease of the oesophagus. It is the least certain of the four.

I left out related codes that don't specifically mean eosinophilic esophagitis:
- general oesophagitis and reflux oesophagitis
- eosinophilic gastritis, gastroenteritis and enteritis
- eosinophil counts and eosinophilia

content.text:
The knowledge store has four codes for eosinophilic esophagitis:

- J1017: Eosinophilic oesophagitis
- ^ESCTEO508265: Eosinophilic esophagitis
- ^ESCT1165474: Food-induced eosinophilic oesophagitis
- ^ESCTEO508286: Eosinophilic ulcer of oesophagus

I left out the related but different conditions that came up in the search. These were eosinophilic gastritis, gastroenteritis, enteritis and colitis, general eosinophilia, and non-eosinophilic oesophagitis such as reflux or erosive. I also left out the broad codes for oesophagitis and oesophageal disease.

I included the eosinophilic ulcer of oesophagus code on judgement. Its name suggests eosinophilic involvement of the oesophagus, but it isn't explicitly labelled as eosinophilic esophagitis.

content.text:
I found three codes for eosinophilic esophagitis in the knowledge store. I ran only one search (on "eosinophilic esophagitis" and "eosinophilic oesophagitis"), so I haven't checked for other spellings or related terms.

- J1017: Eosinophilic oesophagitis
- ^ESCTEO508265: Eosinophilic esophagitis
- ^ESCT1165474: Food-induced eosinophilic oesophagitis

I left out several near matches because they don't indicate this condition:
- ^ESCTEO508286, "Eosinophilic ulcer of oesophagus", is a borderline case. I excluded it because it describes an ulcer rather than the diagnosis itself. Add it if you want a broader list.
- Other eosinophilic conditions (gastritis, gastroenteritis, enteritis, colitis, duodenitis, hypereosinophilic syndrome) affect other sites or are systemic.
- General oesophagitis codes (reflux, erosive, chronic and similar) are not specific to eosinophilic esophagitis.
- Eosinophil count and eosinophilia codes are lab findings, not diagnoses.
